questions.question: What am I doing to get ready for the half marathon?
questions.answer: You're running three times a week (Tuesday, Thursday, Sunday) and following your running club's 16-week plan, at week 6 by the end of October. Your longest run so far is 14 km on 26 October. The race is the Lisbon half marathon in March 2027.

questions.question: Who can help me get an analyst job?
questions.answer: Rui, your mentor, offered to introduce you to Joana Pires, who leads growth at a travel startup that is hiring. Rui's advice is to publish two small analyses on GitHub first, and rebuilding an old campaign report in SQL could be one of them.

questions.question: How much do I need to save for Japan?
questions.answer: About €3,500 including flights, for two weeks in April 2027 (Tokyo, then Kyoto). Saving €300 a month from November covers it by April.
